source_differences: Tube lengths by source: Structurae gives 750 m (eastern) and 786 m (western) with completion in 1976, Lotsberg gives 788 m for the tube of 21 July 1976 and 757 m for the tube of 25 October 1996. Which tube measures 788 m is not settled by the sources.
Length: 788 m in the atlas against 786 m and 750 m on Structurae, the OpenStreetMap geometry measures 764 m and 731 m.
Tube lengths: 786 m left and 786 m right (URSZR Celje, gov.si) against 750 m east and 786 m west (Structurae) and 788 m and 757 m (Lotsberg, English Wikipedia on the A1).
Length on Structurae: 757 m as a single value, against 750 m (eastern tube) and 786 m (western tube) in the atlas.
Number of tubes on Structurae: 1, while its own chronology lists the second tube opened in October 1996.

basis: carriageway 7.7 m plus walkways 0.9 m on both sides, 9.5 m at road level
